briefing.description: Billionaire explorer Elias Thorne was found dead inside his private 'Deep-Sea' pressurized sleeping chamber. The chamber is airtight and monitored 24/7. Oxygen levels were reported as normal, yet Thorne died of asphyxiation. The external seal remained unbroken.
